name: scope-audit
command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path.cwd()
checkpoint = 'ed9f8112352767006ad312d6e7ded6ec0644fea4'
feature = 'android/feature/src/main/kotlin/top/alanvampuke/dininglog/feature/'
allowed = {feature + name for name in ('theme/Colors.kt', 'components/BiteComponents.kt', 'components/QuietGridComponents.kt', 'settings/SettingsScreen.kt')}
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root)
def old(path):
    return git('show', checkpoint + ':' + path).decode('utf-8')
def new(path):
    return (root / path).read_text()
assert str(root) == '/tmp/dining-pr18-fix-0.8.3'
assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == 'fix/pr18-review-0.8.3'
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == checkpoint
baseline = set(git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', checkpoint).decode().splitlines())
for path in sorted(baseline - allowed):
    assert (root / path).read_bytes() == git('show', checkpoint + ':' + path), path
changed = set(git('diff', '--name-only', checkpoint).decode().splitlines())
assert changed & baseline == allowed, changed
added = set(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines()) | (changed - baseline)
assert all(path == 'design/pr18-review/STATIC-FIXES.md' or path.startswith('design/pr18-review/static-evidence/') for path in added), added
print(f'PASS {len(baseline - allowed)} checkpoint files byte-identical; only 4 authorized production files changed')
print('PASS MainActivityContent/InAppUpdates/UpdateIo/seams, startup/install and all other tests, dependencies, workflows, signing, version and auth/session policy unchanged')
for name, count in (('BiteComponents.kt', 2), ('QuietGridComponents.kt', 1)):
    path = feature + 'components/' + name
    text = old(path)
    assert text.count('tenths >= 80') == count
    expected = text.replace('tenths >= 80', 'tenths >= 40').replace('persimmon at 8.0+', 'persimmon at 4.0/5.0')
    assert expected == new(path), path
print('PASS renderer diffs are exactly three InkPaper thresholds and their comments; F3 paint, classic tiers and explicit-unrated contract unchanged')
path = feature + 'theme/Colors.kt'
before = old(path)
after = new(path)
pattern = r'val InkPaperDark = QuietGridColors\((.*?)\n\)'
block = re.search(pattern, before, re.S).group(0)
assert block.count('0xFFE0653A') == 5
expected_block = block.replace('0xFFE0653A', '0xFFE56E44').replace('tertiary = Color(0xFF8F8574)', 'tertiary = Color(0xFF998F7E)')
expected_block = expected_block.replace('    accent = Color(0xFFE56E44), onAccent = Color(0xFFFFFFFF)',
    '    // Warm dark action text keeps contrast through the focused/pressed state layer;\n'
    '    // this persimmon also remains readable as small rating text on paper.\n'
    '    accent = Color(0xFFE56E44), onAccent = Color(0xFF1C1915)')
expected = before.replace(block, expected_block).replace('tertiary = Color(0xFF8A8175)', 'tertiary = Color(0xFF786E60)')
assert expected == after
print('PASS palette diff is exactly active text/accent tokens; classic palettes, warm surfaces and decorative borders unchanged')
path = feature + 'settings/SettingsScreen.kt'
comment = '                        // Functional thumb/border colors are separate from decorative paper rules.\n'
colors = ('                            colors = if (inkPaper) SwitchDefaults.colors(\n'
          '                                uncheckedThumbColor = LocalQuietGridColors.current.secondary,\n'
          '                                uncheckedBorderColor = LocalQuietGridColors.current.secondary,\n'
          '                                uncheckedTrackColor = LocalQuietGridColors.current.surface,\n'
          '                            ) else SwitchDefaults.colors(),\n')
assert new(path).count(comment) == new(path).count(colors) == 1
assert new(path).replace(comment, '').replace(colors, '') == old(path)
print('PASS only enabled unchecked InkPaper Switch colors overridden; classic and disabled default colors preserved')
protected = json.loads(new('android/tools/p8_protected_hashes.json'))
for path, expected in protected.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, path
assert set(git('ls-files', 'backend', 'contracts').decode().splitlines()) == set(protected)
assert not allowed & set(protected)
print(f'PASS all {len(protected)} protected hashes; no protected production entry changed; backend/contracts/migrations unchanged')
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'android/tools'))
from pr18_visual_roles import measurements, rating_threshold, RENDERERS
rows = measurements()
checkpoint_rows = json.loads(old('design/pr18-review/evidence/lightweight/component-roles.json'))['measurements']
def key(row):
    return row['palette'], row['component'], row['state'], row['background']
previous = {key(row): row for row in checkpoint_rows}
assert len(rows) == len(checkpoint_rows) == 42
assert set(map(key, rows)) == set(previous)
for row in rows:
    assert row['ratio'] >= row['minimum'], row
    if row['palette'].startswith('QuietGrid'):
        assert row == previous[key(row)], row
thresholds = {name: rating_threshold(name) for name in RENDERERS}
assert set(thresholds.values()) == {40}
print('PASS all 42 role identities and thresholds retained; classic measurements identical; all current contrast pairs pass')
print('PASS Score/verdictFill/VerdictSticker boundaries are 40; stored 10..50 range unchanged; no Android RED or acceptance claimed')
